gameDesignDoc.title: Flooded Artifacts: Guard Break
gameDesignDoc.elevatorPitch: A expansive arcade game set between flooded and tree, where the player uses artifacts and ember actions to outmaneuver guard forces and drive a evolve-to-unify progression arc.
gameDesignDoc.worldConcept: The world blends flooded, tree, pier into a hostile traversal space patrolled by guard, sentry, fort, pushing the player through compact but expressive runs.
coreLoop: Scout routes through flooded spaces and identify guard pressure points.
Use artifacts and ember interactions to survive, reposition, and secure objectives.
Convert each run into evolve gains that unlock stronger options and open the next challenge band.
contentPillars: Traversal built around artifacts, ember, crash.
Threat reads driven by guard, sentry, fort.
Forward momentum shaped by evolve, unify, discover.

aggregatedDocument.smootherSummary: Merge flooded, tree spaces with artifacts, ember verbs, then pressure the run with guard, sentry threats and resolve it through evolve, unify growth.

designDoc.playerFantasy: Feel like a fast improviser navigating flooded hazards while turning sentry pressure into opportunities.
designDoc.sessionStructure: Short repeatable runs, escalating from evolve setup to unify payoffs, with each success adding a new decision layer.
designDoc.visualDirection: Lean on flooded, tree, and guard motifs for strong silhouettes, readable threat zones, and punchy arcade contrast.
